metadata.description: Hire an Engineer by Bilawal (github.com/bilawalbaig8): an AI senior software engineer for people who don't code, with role sub-agents and a live agent crew view for Claude Code.

plugins.name: hire-an-engineer
plugins.description: The Hire an Engineer skill: your AI tool plans, builds, tests, ships and documents your project in plain language, and asks before anything risky. Installs its role sub-agents and the agent crew view with it.

plugins.name: agent-crew
plugins.description: A pane beside the chat that shows your AI engineering team at work: each agent as a little Claude with its model, effort and the file it is on.
